head.title: AI Desktop Studio — six generation workshops, one window
head.description: Multimodal desktop application: image, video, 3D, audio, textures and skyboxes in a dockable panel interface. Offline dictation and control through an MCP server.
head.ogTitle: AI Desktop Studio — six generation workshops, one window
head.ogDescription: Six generation workshops in a single window. Electron, React 19, TypeScript. macOS, Windows, Linux.

hero.lede: Six generation workshops in a single window. Dockable panels, a timecoded timeline, an inspector, a library on disk: the tools of production software, applied to generative models.

home.title: A project is a folder. Nothing more.
home.lede: Open a folder and it becomes a project: documents, imported assets, generations. Everything stays on disk, in formats other software already reads — OpenRaster, OpenTimelineIO, glTF, MaterialX — browsed from the application and versioned by git without leaving the window.
home.alt: Home screen: a banner to resume the last project, a list of recently opened projects, shortcuts to the six workshops, a feed of creations published by everyone, and the account library panel.

0.title: Six spaces, one window
0.text: Image, Video, 3D, Audio, Materials and Skyboxes. Each has its own tools and opens in a tab, beside the others.

1.title: Dockable and detachable
1.text: Models, Explorer, Assets, Inspector, Timeline. Arrange the window as you like; the layout is remembered per workshop.

2.title: Disk first
2.text: Generations land in the project folder. The remote account library plugs in afterwards, with an API key.

video.lede: Two monitors, a multitrack timeline, and models that produce the shots.

0.text: Source and Program, as on an editing station: the chosen clip on one side, the edit as it will be exported on the other.

1.text: Video and audio tracks, selection, blade and hand tools, timecoded playback.

2.text: Sequence-to-Video, Video Cut, Video Concat, Video Studio.

video.alt: Video workshop: Source and Program monitors side by side, Assets panel, clip inspector, four-track timeline V1, A1, V2 and A2.

threeD.lede: A generated mesh, placed in a scene you light, animate and export.

0.text: Grid, orientation gizmo and an overlaid counter: triangles, vertices, draw calls, texture memory.

1.text: Five sources — ambient, directional, hemispheric, point, spot — exposed as tracks, with keyframes on the timeline.

2.text: The mesh leaves as .glb wherever you drop it, ready for an engine.

threeD.alt: 3D workshop: a generated car placed in a mountain setting, move gizmo and triangle counter overlaid, scene tree and inspector on the right, light timeline at the bottom.

image.lede: A layered canvas, where generation is one tool among the others.

0.text: Stacking, visibility, locking. Every generation arrives as a layer, above what is already there.

1.text: Move, hand, scale, frame, selection, shapes, brush, pencil, eraser, text, layer fill, eyedropper.

2.text: The inspector keeps the model that produced the layer, its weight and its creation date.

image.alt: Image workshop: a transparent canvas with a cut-out skeleton, model catalogue on the left, Layers and Inspector panels on the right, asset strip at the bottom.

audio.lede: Compose and edit sound across several tracks, in the same window as the rest.

0.text: Multitrack editing, the same tools as the video timeline, playback locked to the same timecode.

1.text: Computed in a separate process: an hour of sound does not freeze the interface while it is analysed.

2.text: Music, ambiences and effects, generated by the API then dropped straight onto a track.

audio.alt: Audio workshop: Program monitor showing the waveform of the edit, Source monitor below, catalogue of sound generation models, four-track audio timeline.

textures.lede: A material, not an image: each channel is produced then checked separately.

0.text: Eight: Base colour, Normal, Roughness, Metal, Occlusion, Height, Emission, Cavity. Seven come out of a generation, Emission is set right here; all export file by file.

1.text: The material is applied to a test volume — sphere, cube, cylinder, plane, knot — and lit in real time, before export.

2.text: Channels tileable at 4096 × 4096, usable as they are in an engine.

textures.alt: Materials workshop: preview cube carrying the material, inspector open on the channels — base colour and normal — then on the material settings, strip of generated images.

skyboxes.lede: A sky that serves as a backdrop and, at the same time, as a light source.

0.text: 360°, equirectangular, cross, six faces. Switch from one view to another without re-exporting.

1.text: Adjustable field of view and test objects, to judge the light on a matte sphere and a glossy one.

2.text: The sky produced here lights the 3D workshop scene directly.

skyboxes.alt: Skyboxes workshop: a snowy mountain sky in 360-degree projection, two test spheres on the ground — one matte, one mirror — and sun settings on the right.

architecture.title: No generation form is written by hand.
architecture.lede: A model's parameters are its own and change without warning. They are therefore read at runtime and turned into fields: a new model shows up with its settings, without one more line of code.

0.title: Six modes, one layout
0.text: Dockable and detachable panels, tabs, a layout remembered per workshop between sessions.

1.title: Rebuilt from their state
1.text: Detaching a panel destroys its graphics context. The engine rebuilds itself identically — which gives undo and saving at the same time.

2.title: Project folder
2.text: A project is a folder readable without the application, browsed by a real file explorer and tracked by git from the studio — branches, versions, conflicts. Import, export and catalogue share one index, which finds its files again even when they are moved outside the application.

3.title: The fields come from the model
3.text: The schema the model declares becomes a list of fields, rendered as such. An unknown type falls back to raw input rather than making the form disappear.

4.title: One place asks
4.text: Every generation is asynchronous. A single component follows progress, caps the number of concurrent tasks and backs off when the service refuses.

5.title: The interface never sees the key
5.text: Key and secret are encrypted by the system store. The window asks “am I signed in?”, never “what is my key?”.

6.title: Offline, entirely
6.text: A speech recognition engine runs in a separate process, on your computer. Once the model is fetched, nothing that is said leaves for the network.

7.title: The studio is driven from outside
7.text: 233 actions across 16 families, from documents to assets, from the scene to the edit, from the file to the git repository: an agent does what the interface does, by the same paths.

8.title: The display thread stays free
8.text: Thumbnails, waveforms, heavy meshes and video encoding go to the graphics processor, into worker threads or into a separate process.

download.title: Three platforms, one repository.
download.lede: Five installers, produced by the same integration pipeline at every release. Until the first public release, the repository clones and runs in three commands.
download.note: The installer is governed by the terms of use; the source code, by the PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 licence. The application gives access to no generation service: it uses the API key you provide, under your account and at your expense.
